2: For the music director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. O Yahweh, you favored your land. You restored the fortunes of Jacob.
3: You took away the guilt of your people; you covered all their sin. Selah
4: You withdrew all your wrath; you turned from your burning anger.
5: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and annul your vexation with us.
6: Will you be angry against us forever? Will you prolong your anger generation after generation?
7: Will you not again revive us, that your people might rejoice in you?
8: Show us, O Yahweh, your loyal love, and grant us your salvation.
9: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, because he will speak peace to his people, even his faithful ones, but let them not return to folly.
10: Surely his salvation is near for those who fear him, that glory may abide in our land.
11: Loyal love and faithfulness will meet one another; righteousness and peace will kiss.
12: Faithfulness will sprout from the ground, and righteousness will look down from heaven.
13: Yes, Yahweh will give what is good, and our land will give its produce.
14: Righteousness will go before him, and it will make his steps a pathway.
